gates.name: Proof-only scoring contract
gates.evidence: The proof-v2 contract pins the same nine hash-checked Cairo, fold, and integrated pipeline jobs for CUDA, Metal, and CPU. Protected exact Cairo, wrap, and fold timers are merged in stwo-zig PR #213. Direct M5 receipts exercise those intervals, but a trusted proof-v2 judge and fresh paired baselines are still required for ranking.

gates.name: Contract and data
gates.evidence: The nine proof-v2 jobs use one hash-pinned public manifest across three backends; contract and file-integrity checks pass. The former ten-case H200 command-time epoch remains archived.

gates.name: Independent verifiers
gates.evidence: Direct proof-v2 M5 runs check exact Cairo proof and circuit root bytes against pinned references; Cairo product verification is enabled. The proof-v2 judge must independently verify every public and private proof, including circuit roots.

gates.name: Public proofs and folds
gates.evidence: CPU and Metal M5 Max each reproduce all nine current-reference Cairo, fold, and integrated pipeline outputs with exact proof-stage timers. The current-pin H200 basket remains unmeasured.

gates.name: Private holdout
gates.evidence: Existing holdout assets pass local hash preflight, but the proof-v2 judge has not mounted or qualified private cases.

gates.name: Paired scoring
gates.evidence: The proof-v2 scorer checks exact stage counts and equally weights Cairo, recursion, and pipeline families. Direct one-pass M5 observations are unranked; no paired baseline/candidate rounds or A/A dispersion study exists for this epoch.

gates.name: Intake and dispatch
gates.evidence: Trial submissions and direct comparisons work locally; a self-hosted proof-v2 runner, trusted receipt signing, and backend-specific promotion remain to be wired.

gates.name: Candidate isolation
gates.evidence: The earlier CPU sandbox probe does not qualify proof-v2. Candidate isolation, immutable inputs, and GPU access must be checked on each actual ranking worker.
